The Linux and Snap release of **The Last Pocket 0.5.4** by QuietByte.

This packaging update corrects Snap licence metadata compatibility. Gameplay is unchanged from0.5.3.

- Ten cue-sports modes, including8-ball,9-ball,10-ball, straight pool, blackball, snooker and carom.
- Local two-player matches on one PC, or a48-rival AI championship across Amateur, Professional, Master and GOAT.
- Original comic portraits, table upgrades, three continue diamonds, saved progress and local top-ten scores.
- Glossy rolling balls, animated aiming, stereo effects and independently mutable lounge music.
- Clear numbered pocket selection before the final8-ball shot.

**Linux x86-64:** download the archive, extract it and run `TheLastPocket/play.sh`. OpenGL3.3-capable graphics required. The game targets60FPS; actual performance varies by hardware. There is no network multiplayer.

Aim with the mouse, click to lock direction, set power with the wheel or left meter, then press Space/Enter or Shoot. For the final8-ball, choose a numbered pocket1–6 first. Escape pauses; N mutes music and M mutes effects.

Source and original graphics/effects are Apache-2.0. Bundled music has separate permission for redistribution within the game; see NOTICE. Font and engine licences are included.
